messages:
ana: Quick sync — drafting PRD for a "Lite" embeddings tier customers are asking for: low-cost, lower-dim vectors for search/rerank. Want to align on acceptance criteria, API surface, and rollout plan. Proposed API: keep same embeddings endpoint, add `quality: \"lite\" | \"standard\"`. Thoughts?

mike: +1. Need to quantify cost delta. How much cheaper? Also routing implications for hosted vs dedicated. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

lina: Acceptance criteria suggestions:
- p95 inference latency <= 50ms for hosted small requests
- unit cost <= ~1/3 of standard embeddings
- embedding dim <= 256 for lite
- deterministic outputs for same input (no random init)
- clear fallback to standard model if quality check fails

jasper: API naming preference: `engine=embed-lite` seems clearer for ops and routing. `quality` param is flexible but complicates model selection.

ana: I prefer single endpoint + `quality` param so customers don't need to change routing. Tradeoff: runtime must map param -> model variant, caching keys must include quality.

devex-joe: SDK work required. Example request shape we'd need to support in SDKs and examples: ```json
{ \"model\": \"redwood-embed-1\", \"quality\": \"lite\", \"truncate\": true }
``` Will add to SDK PR checklist.

mike: Major edge case: differing vector dims across quality will break existing downstream pipelines (index shape, similarity code). We need migration docs and a deprecation timeline for dimensions change.

lina: Add to acceptance criteria: provide a migration helper or export tool to reindex/transform existing vectors. Also require regression tests on representative customer datasets.

ana: Launch gating proposal:
- Canary: 10% traffic on hosted API and 5 customers on dedicated
- Telemetry: track vector dim, latency, cost per call, and downstream rerank nDCG delta
- Blockers: any customer rerank dataset with >5% nDCG degradation must block rollout

jasper: Test plan: run rerank eval harness across 5 customer-provided prompt sets and internal benchmarks. If >5% drop, require rollback or tune quantization.

release-bot: deploy scheduled to prod-dedicated at 1767778890 by @eng-runtime

ana: I'll update the PRD with these bullets and add a short section on pricing/legal implications for a new tier. @mike can you own the SDK changes? :thumbsup:

mike: Yep — I'll open the SDK PR and add changelog + examples today.

ana: Thanks all — I'll ping when PRD draft is up for review.
